purpose: Reviewed, sourced rules for screening OpenAQ Vietnam inventory records. Placement and identity are decided here, in code, from evidence that is documented rather than inferred from a name. A semantic model is asked only about records that no rule resolves.
provenance: Rules were written after independent verification of 6 locations and 6 candidate pairs on 2026-09-17 (see docs/research/typesafe_screening.md). The AirGradient and EPA rules come from manufacturer and agency documentation, not from the verified labels.
caveats: The identity distance thresholds (100 m, 10000 m) are proposals derived from the six verified pairs. They are project decisions and require sign-off before this file is treated as reviewed.
The identity rules reproduce the six verified pairs by construction, because those pairs were used to choose the thresholds. That is not validation; it is a compact, inspectable restatement.
Candidate pairs are only generated where normalised names are at least 80 percent similar, so identity screening cannot see a same-station pair whose names differ.
No rule resolves the 37 Hanoi network stations or the HabitatMap community sensors; those remain the model's only remaining subject and its answers are hints for review, never dispositions.

placement_rules.source_note: AirGradient documents Open Air (Model O-1PST) as an outdoor air quality monitor.
AirGradient documents ONE (Model I-9PSL / I-9PSL-DE) as an indoor air quality monitor.

placement_rules.basis: US EPA documentation of the Department of State embassy and consulate monitor network.
placement_rules.source_note: EPA states that the embassies and consulates map displays data from reference-grade air quality monitors at U.S. embassies and consulates, reporting ambient PM2.5. The project's own qualification report identifies these inventory records as the diplomatic-post feeds.

identity_rules.source_note: Records this far apart cannot describe one physical station, however similar the names.
Identical name inside the co-location radius. Threshold is a proposed project decision, not a measured value.

identity_rules.basis: Default when no rule resolves the pair.
identity_rules.source_note: A human decides. Includes same-name records between the two distance thresholds, which may be one redeployed device or two devices.
